events.title: Age of Failon – Steam Key Giveaway!
events.summary: Hello everyone!To celebrate our participation in Steam Next Fest, we're hosting a giveaway for Age of Failon – Birth of the Hero!This is a small thank-you to everyone who has shown interest in the game, tried the demo, or shared their thoughts during development.What can you win?We're giving away up to 80 Steam keys for the full game!How to participateDownload and launch the free demo on Steam.Select Giveaway from the main menu to receive your unique participation code.Visit our giveaway website

events.title: Demo Update 0.5.0 Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello, Heroes!A new update for Age of Failon – Birth of the Hero is here!Version 0.5.0 focuses on improving the user interface, introducing a new tooltip system, redesigning mouse cursors, and fixing several issues.What's New & ImprovedCompletely Redesigned Cursors – All mouse cursors have received a visual overhaul, making different actions easier to recognize.Improved Cursor Behavior – Fixed incorrect cursor states, including the disabled cursor appearing over interface elements.Smarter Spell

events.title: Demo Update 0.3.0 – Progression, Maps & Save System

events.title: Age of Failon – A Major Development Update
events.summary: It has been a while since the last update here on Steam, but development of Age of Failon: Birth of the Hero certainly hasn’t stopped.Quite the opposite.Over the past months, the game has gone through some of the largest changes since development began.
